# Book Club, October

Six of us at Sam's flat. We talked about [[Piranesi]].

Most people loved the narrator's voice. Two found the middle slow. Sam picked it because I had pushed [[The Overstory]] on everyone last spring and the group wanted something shorter.

Next month: Braiding Sweetgrass, chosen by Ines. Meeting at the library cafe on 9 November.
